title: Docker compose integration with API proxy
description: Set up docker-compose.yml and verify full stack: Express API running, React webapp dev server proxying /api to API service.
steps: Create workspace/docker-compose.yml: service api (build ./simple-notes-api, port 3001), service webapp (build ./simple-notes-webapp, port 5173, depends_on api)
Create Dockerfile for simple-notes-api (multi-stage build: install deps, tsc build, node dist)
Create Dockerfile for simple-notes-webapp (dev-oriented: node image, npm install, vite dev server with --host 0.0.0.0)
Ensure webapp vite proxy points to api service hostname inside docker network (http://api:3001) via env var override
Verify: docker compose up -d --build, curl http://localhost:3001/api/notes returns [], curl http://localhost:5173 serves the SPA
Test end-to-end CRUD via curl POST/PUT/DELETE against http://localhost:3001/api/notes
Tear down stack (docker compose down -v) before finishing
